summary: Code review passed. fetchIndex() orchestrates the three new methods in the correct order. The critical snapshot-before-reset invariant is upheld. Additive-mode interaction is silently correct. The merge-then-autoPopulate ordering handles blank preserved values correctly. No changes to _fetchIndex, parseIndex, registerEpisode, or any driver confirmed.

comments.note: In additive mode, mergePreservedMetadata is a no-op for pre-existing entries because they already carry their metadata from the loaded file. The behaviour is correct but could have a brief comment noting this (e.g., '// For additive sources, pre-existing entries already carry their metadata; merge only applies to new episodes'). Non-blocking.

The merge-then-autoPopulate ordering correctly handles previously-blank preserved values: array_key_exists (not isset) in mergePreservedMetadata allows a blank ''chapter'' to be merged; autoPopulateFromEpisodes then catches the empty string and re-evaluates from info.json. This two-pass approach is deliberately correct, not accidental.
